title: Network Security Controls Policy & Architecture
category: BUILD AND MAINTAIN A SECURE NETWORK
blurb: A network security control (NSC) management policy and procedure are documented, in use, and known to all affected parties.
controlQuestion: Is a formal network security control (NSC) policy and procedure documented, actively maintained, and communicated to all relevant personnel?
controlActivities:
1. Review published NSC policies and procedures.
2. Confirm annual owner review and sign-off.
3. Sample personnel to verify policy dissemination.
discussion: Customized Approach Objective for PCI-1.1.1: Verify that network security control (NSC) processes are officially documented, approved by management, and distributed to responsible teams across all cardholder data environment (CDE) boundaries.

title: Primary Account Number (PAN) Storage Protection
blurb: The primary account number (PAN) is rendered unreadable anywhere it is stored using strong cryptography, truncated hashes, or index tokens.
controlQuestion: Is stored Primary Account Number (PAN) data rendered completely unreadable across all database tables, logs, and backup media?
controlActivities:
1. Inspect database schema definitions for AES-256 encryption or tokenization.
2. Review key management procedures and rotation logs.
3. Inspect application logs to verify PAN masking.
discussion: Customized Approach Objective for PCI-3.4.1: Ensure cardholder data is protected at rest using strong industry-standard cryptographic keys or secure tokenization mechanisms.

title: Strong Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Implementation
blurb: Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is implemented for all access into the CDE and for all remote administrative access.
controlQuestion: Is MFA required for all administrative and user access into the cardholder data environment?
controlActivities:
1. Review IAM and identity provider MFA configuration settings.
2. Sample user login logs and verify 2FA/MFA challenge enforcement.
3. Inspect VPN and bastion host authentication rules.
discussion: Customized Approach Objective for PCI-8.3.6: Prevent unauthorized access to cardholder data environments by requiring at least two distinct authentication factors.
